description: Mirascope call with one tool, traced by Mirascope's ops tracing inside one session.
notes: ops.configure and ops.instrument_llm on the harness provider, inside ops.session(id sess-1). A @ops.trace function wraps the call, and another wraps the run that resumes the tool loop. The model is openai:completions/gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 and the provider is registered at the mock (M4 spike, finding 9). Trace spans are chain spans.
